title: ServiceNow Administrator
summary: ServiceNow administrators keep a company's ServiceNow instance (its IT ticketing and workflow platform) running well, mostly through configuration rather than code. They sit in the IT service management team, managing users and access, catalog items, reports and upgrades, and pass bigger builds to developers.
dailyDuties: Add and update users, groups and roles
Create catalog items, forms and notifications
Move changes between instances with update sets
Build reports and dashboards for IT managers
Resolve platform tickets and find root causes
Test the instance before and after upgrades and patches
Agree new requests with process owners

skills.expectation: Run the ServiceNow instance: users, groups, roles, ACLs, catalog items, notifications, reports, update sets and upgrades
Know incident, problem, change and request processes the ITIL way
Build and fix simple approval and task flows without code
Run regression tests on forms, catalog items and flows before each upgrade
Resolve L2 tickets about the platform and find root causes
Explain changes to process owners and write clear release notes
Take requests from IT teams and process owners and agree priorities
Read and tweak business rules and client scripts
Write small scripts when configuration is not enough
Keep CMDB data clean and support Discovery
Maintain portal pages and knowledge articles
Set up LDAP or SSO sign-in for users
Write admin runbooks and user guides

certifications.why: The entry ServiceNow certification that most admin postings require.
ServiceNow work is built around ITSM processes, and many postings list ITIL Foundation.
